name: Public Joint-Stock Company Rosseti Moscow Region
summary: Public Joint-Stock Company "Rosseti Moscow Region", together with its subsidiaries, engages in the transmission of electricity through electrical networks primarily in Moscow, Russia. It also installs, repairs, and maintains electrical equipment; and offers technical connection services. The company was formerly known as Public Joint Stock Company “Moscow United Electric Grid Company” and changed its name to Public Joint Stock Company “Rosseti Moscow Region” in July 2020. The company is headquartered in Moscow, Russia. Public Joint-Stock Company "Rosseti Moscow Region" operates as a subsidiary of Rosseti, Public Joint Stock Company.
